subject: Maths
title: Roti ko barabar baantna: fractions
description: Roti aur doston ki madad se fraction ko hisson ke roop mein samjho.
transcript:
Namaste! Aaj hum fractions ko ghar ke ek bilkul aam scene se samjhenge. Socho, garam roti bani hai aur use chaar doston mein barabar baantna hai. Roti ko chaar same-size hisson mein kaato. Har hissa poori roti ka one-fourth, yaani ek-batta-chaar, hai. Fraction mein neeche ka number batata hai ki poori cheez ko kitne barabar hisson mein baanta. Upar ka number batata hai ki hum unmein se kitne hisse dekh rahe hain.

Agar tum ek hissa lete ho, to tumhare paas one-fourth hai. Do hisse milkar two-fourths hote hain. Dhyaan rahe, hisson ka size barabar hona chahiye. Agar ek tukda bada aur doosra chhota hai, to unhe equal fourths nahi keh sakte. Ek paper circle banao, use fold karke chaar barabar parts dikhao. Ab teen parts rang do. Rang wala hissa three-fourths hai. Picture dekhkar fraction likhna aasaan hota hai.

Ab ek chhota sawaal: agar roti ko do barabar parts mein baantkar ek part khaya, to kitna hissa khaya? One-half. Fraction ko padhte waqt pehle numerator, phir denominator bolo. Aaj ka recap: denominator total equal parts batata hai, numerator liye gaye parts batata hai, aur equal-size parts bahut zaroori hain. Agli baar plate par fruit baantte hue khud fraction dhoondhna!

title: Alag fractions, barabar hissa
description: Equivalent fractions ko rang-bhare paper strips se dekho.
transcript:
Kabhi do alag fractions ek hi amount dikhate hain. Is idea ko equivalent fractions kehte hain. Ek paper strip lo aur use do barabar parts mein fold karo. Ek part rangne par one-half milta hai. Ab doosri strip ko chaar equal parts mein baanto aur do parts rang do. Yeh two-fourths hai. Rang wala area dono strips mein barabar hai, isliye one-half aur two-fourths equivalent hain.

Yeh jaadu nahi, equal groups ka idea hai. Numerator aur denominator dono ko ek hi number se multiply karne par fraction ki value wahi rehti hai. One-half ko do se multiply karo: upar one times two, neeche two times two. Humein two-fourths milta hai. Hamesha dono numbers par same operation karo. Sirf numerator ko badaloge to amount badal jayega.

Ghar mein ek chocolate bar ko do equal pieces mein se ek lena, chaar pieces mein se do lene jaisa hi hai. Lekin pieces equal size ke hone chahiye. Ek drawing banao: pehli rectangle ko do parts mein baanto aur ek rang do. Doosri rectangle ko chaar parts mein baanto aur do rang do. Ab areas compare karo. Aaj yaad rakho: equivalent fractions likhne mein numbers alag ho sakte hain, par dikhaya gaya hissa same hota hai. Picture se jaanchna ek achha tareeka hai.

title: Rupees aur paise mein decimal

transcript:
Aaj hum decimals ko bazaar ke bill se samjhenge. Ek rupaye mein sau paise hote hain. Agar pencil ki keemat chaar rupaye aur pachaas paise hai, to ise 4.50 rupees likhte hain. Decimal point rupees aur paise ke hisson ko alag dikhata hai. Point ke turant baad wala digit tenths ki jagah, aur uske baad wala hundredths ki jagah hota hai.

Number 4.50 mein four poore rupees hain, five tenths of a rupee aur zero hundredths. Five tenths rupee pachaas paise ke barabar hote hain. Dhyaan do: 4.5 aur 4.50 ka amount same hai. Aakhri zero jodne se value nahi badalti, kyunki paise ke hundredths mein kuch extra nahi joda gaya.

Ab apne aas-paas ka example: agar aam ka juice 12 rupaye 25 paise ka hai, bill par 12.25 likh sakte hain. Decimal point ke dono taraf ki jagah ko sahi padho. 12.25 ka matlab 12 rupees aur 25 paise hai; 12.5 ka matlab 12 rupees aur 50 paise. Dono alag hain. Ek imaginary dukaan banao, teen cheezein chuno aur unke daam rupees-paise format mein likho. Recap: decimal point whole rupees ko paise se alag karta hai; do digits paise dikhate hain; aur 4.5 aur 4.50 barabar value hain.

title: Decimal ki place-value seedhi

Socho ek metre ki ribbon ko das barabar pieces mein kaata. Har piece one-tenth metre hai. Ek piece ko phir das chhote equal parts mein baanto, to har chhota part one-hundredth metre hoga. Decimal place-value isi tarah har step par ten times chhota hota jata hai. Point ko dekhkar direction samjho: left mein bade whole places, right mein chhote fractional places.

Ab 2.06 ko padho. Isme two ones, zero tenths aur six hundredths hain. Beech ka zero important hai; ise hata kar 2.6 likhne se value badal jaati hai. 2.06 mein chhe hundredths hain, lekin 2.6 mein chhe tenths. Har digit ki jagah uski value batati hai.

title: Boundary walk aur perimeter

transcript:
Maan lo school ke chhote garden ke chaaron taraf chalna hai. Boundary ke poore chakkar ki lambai ko perimeter kehte hain. Rectangle garden ke chaar sides hote hain. Har side ki length add karo: length plus width plus length plus width. Agar length aath metre aur width paanch metre ho, to perimeter aath plus paanch plus aath plus paanch, yaani chhabbees metre hai.

Perimeter shape ke bahar ke kinaare ka total distance hai. Area alag hota hai: woh andar ki surface kitni jagah leti hai. Abhi hum boundary par dhyaan de rahe hain. Ek notebook page ko ungli se kinaare par trace karo. Tum page ke perimeter ke raaste par chal rahe ho. Chhoti sides aur badi sides dono count karo; ek bhi side chhootni nahi chahiye.

Ek square ka har side chhe centimetre hai. Uska perimeter kya hoga? Chaar sides ko jodo: six plus six plus six plus six, yaani twenty-four centimetres. Square mein four times side bhi keh sakte ho. Ghar par kisi table ka measure karne se pehle adult se poochho aur ruler ka sahi istemal karo. Aaj ke recap mein: perimeter outside boundary ka total, sab side lengths add karna, aur answer mein length ki unit likhna yaad rakho. Apne desk ki boundary ko aankhon se trace karo aur socho, kaun si sides add hongi?

title: Dhoop se baadal tak paani ka safar
description: Dhoop, evaporation aur clouds ke beech paani ka safar jaaniye.
transcript:
Aaj paani ki ek boond ke saath safar karte hain. Socho, baarish ke baad chhat par thoda paani reh gaya. Dhoop padne par kuch der mein paani kam dikhne lagta hai. Liquid paani garam hokar water vapour naam ki gas banta hai. Is process ko evaporation kehte hain. Water vapour hawa mein upar jaata hai, lekin hum ise aksar dekh nahi paate.

Upar hawa thandi hoti hai. Water vapour thanda hokar bahut chhoti liquid droplets mein badalta hai. Is process ka naam condensation hai. Bahut si droplets milkar clouds banati hain. Bathroom ke thande mirror par nahaane ke baad chhote water drops dikhte hain; yeh condensation ka ek everyday example hai. Clouds mein paani jama hota rehta hai.

Jab droplets badi aur bhaari hoti hain, to baarish ke roop mein neeche gir sakti hain. Paani mitti, nadi, talaab aur samundar tak pahunchta hai. Phir dhoop ise dobara garam karti hai aur cycle chalta rehta hai. Aasmaan ke clouds cotton jaise dikhte hain, par unmein water droplets hoti hain. Recap: dhoop evaporation mein madad karti hai, thandi hawa condensation karti hai, aur droplets milkar clouds banati hain. Khidki se aasman dekho aur socho, paani ki boond abhi cycle ke kis step par hai?

Aaj hum aam baarish ko example bana rahe hain.

Baarish ka paani chhat se pipe mein, phir naali aur nadi mein ja sakta hai. Kuch paani mitti ke andar soak hokar groundwater banata hai. Talaab aur jheel paani ko kuch samay ke liye jama rakhte hain. Is jama hone wale step ko collection keh sakte hain. Isliye barsaat ka paani sirf sadak par behkar gayab nahi hota; uska kuch hissa zameen aur jalashayon tak pahunchta hai.

Agar baarish bahut tez ho, to sadkon par paani bhar sakta hai. Safai se drains khule rakhna aur rainwater harvesting jaise tareeke paani ko sambhalne mein madad karte hain. Bina adult ke permission ke baarish ke tez paani ke paas mat jao. Notebook mein arrows banao: cloud, rain, soil, river, sun. Arrows se dikhao paani cycle mein kaise wapas jaata hai. Recap: precipitation paani ko neeche laata hai, collection use rivers/lakes/ground mein jama karta hai, aur dhoop cycle ko phir se shuru kar sakti hai.

Kya beej ko andhere mein forever rakhna chahiye? Sprout shuru hone ke baad growing plant ko roshni ki zaroorat hoti hai. Paani bhi chahiye, lekin bahut zyada paani se hawa kam mil sakti hai. Isliye balance aur observation important hain. Beej ka har sprout ek hi din mein nahi aata.
